parameter_bounds: LOWER and UPPER in workspace/model.py, inclusive
model: H0 + Cx cos(kx) + Sx sin(kx) + Cy cos(ky) + Sy sin(ky) on [0,2pi)^2; workspace/model.py is authoritative
target: lowest eigenstate; every retained window contains it
window_selection: lowest M sorted eigenstates independently at each momentum; exclude self from response sum
response: -2 Im sum_m <0|dH/dkx|m><m|dH/dky|0>/(E0-Em)^2 integrated over the torus and divided by 2pi
signed_plateau_definition: mean(window responses) times rounded full Chern number
robustness_audit: each of the first 21 parameters separately shifted by plus/minus 0.002; evaluated even if the perturbed design is slightly outside nominal coefficient bounds
scope: finite deterministic perturbation audit, not a universal certificate for every point in a continuous uncertainty box
